generation.explanation: An inscribed angle is half the measure of the arc it intercepts—the arc between the two fixed endpoints that does not contain the moving point. Drag the yellow point around the circle: the angle stays at 50° while you remain on the same arc. Crossing an endpoint switches it to the supplementary angle, 130°; at the endpoints themselves, the angle is undefined.
